Recorded claim:
The direct RNP conversion left a TODO that the import filter may pass user IDs while the underlying implementation expects fingerprints. The same warning remains in current keyRing code. Review accepted the patch without resolving that uncertainty. A change to limitedUids or importPubkeyBlockAutoAcceptImpl needs a focused test for which keys and identities are accepted; this code comment is a concern, not proof of an observed failure.

Provenance: ec716b6fc08813b37edf51c5fe53cab161f37a1acea2a19c0b28e70b1aecf081. Original evidence IDs: 45f4be4595ae286636e4d14d05fab2bdc7e49df917d2f20d5cb712ac3d4db11b, 9c887aa06a639d974fe733dca0e5bd4a32439d90727ea1101da6a6b6d15411f1, be64709bde645427536d53d725e3fdc4cb1fd937f7f26d7f764f7313ec7d795d.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
